// GREEN fixture for `no-untagged-personal-data` — the GDPR-OWNED slice (P-GA-03 / P-051).
// The lint MUST admit this. This is the deliberate confirmation that the lint admits the ACTUAL
// FROZEN `#[personal_data(...)]` attribute shape — the full SIX-TAG keyword form frozen in
// P-GA-02 / P-050 (gdpr-and-audit §2.1: `category | role | basis | retention | erasure |
// subject_locator`), not merely the short single-arg floor form the substrate fixtures use. Every
// PII-bearing field carries the canonical multi-line tag, so the generated data-map / RoPA (Art. 30)
// and the crypto-shred / pseudonymise erasure fan-out (Art. 17) reach it. Non-PII columns
// (`subject_ref`, `tenant`, `region`) need no tag — they are opaque references.
pub struct ConsentRow {
    pub subject_ref: SubjectRef,
    #[personal_data(
        category = ContactInfo,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = TenantPolicy,
        erasure = CryptoShred(subject_dek),
        subject_locator = "subject_ref",
    )]
    pub email: EncryptedField<Email>,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Identifier,
        role = PlatformOperational,
        basis = LegalObligation,
        retention = AuditCarveOut(Duration::days(2555)),
        erasure = Pseudonymise,
        subject_locator = "subject_ref",
    )]
    pub full_name: EncryptedField<FullName>,
    #[personal_data(
        category = ContactInfo,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Consent(consent_id),
        retention = UntilContractEnd,
        erasure = CryptoShred(subject_dek),
        subject_locator = "subject_ref",
    )]
    pub phone: EncryptedField<Phone>,
    pub tenant: TenantId,
    pub region: Region,
}
